_comment: #75 shared-heap MUC-light fan-out A/B. The ScenarioConfig struct is PM-shaped (enforce_keys), so the MUC knobs (users_per_room = fan-out width, rooms_per_user, messages_sent_per_room, room_message_interval, room_creation_interval, delay_before_creating_rooms, message_body) are set as AMOC_* env on the amoc-worker service in local.compose.yml — the dynamic_domains_muc_light scenario reads AMOC_<UPPER>. Here: users=300 mapped to USERS; delay_before_s=20 -> AMOC_DELAY_BEFORE_SENDING_MESSAGES; delay_after_s=10 -> AMOC_DELAY_AFTER_SENDING_MESSAGES. pre_sampling_wait_s=70 skips the connect + room-creation + pre-send ramp so the sampling window lands in steady groupchat sending; measurement_duration_s=90 samples that plateau. Real groupchat stanzas are small terms (message/body wrappers + a refc-binary body) so the fan-out copy tax is modest vs the term-heavy pattern bench — high AMOC_USERS_PER_ROOM (in compose) maximizes the real-broker effect; a modest A/B delta is itself the honest answer for this workload.
